description: This file contains utility methods for working with help text related to entity fields within the Ofbiz framework, specifically retrieving help descriptions for entity fields considering localization and entity metadata.

classes.name: UtilHelpText
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve help text descriptions for entity fields in the Ofbiz framework.

methods.name: getEntityFieldDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the help text associated with a specific entity's field, looking up localized descriptions from resource bundles, and defaulting to resource property keys if no specific help text is found.
